Abstract Text: Worker entered a confined space without atmospheric testing.
Event Description: A technician entered a storage vessel to inspect internal components without conducting atmospheric testing before entry. H2S was detected shortly after entry and the worker exited immediately. No injury occurred.

Abstract Text: Worker stood beneath a suspended load during lifting operations.
Event Description: During equipment lifting, a worker entered the exclusion zone and stood beneath a suspended pump. The load remained stable and was lowered without incident. No injury occurred.
Event Keywords: suspended load, line of fire, lifting

Abstract Text: Worker performed roof installation without fall protection.
Event Description: A worker was installing roofing material approximately 25 feet above ground without an effective fall protection system. The worker maintained balance and completed the task without falling.

Abstract Text: Electrical maintenance was performed without lockout tagout.
Event Description: An electrician began maintenance on an electrical panel without verifying isolation. The circuit was unexpectedly energized during the task. The worker stepped away before contact occurred and no injury resulted.

Abstract Text: Damaged office chair identified during housekeeping inspection.
Event Description: A damaged office chair with a loose wheel was identified during a routine housekeeping inspection. The chair was removed from service and replaced. No one was exposed to a significant hazard.

Abstract Text: Worker narrowly avoided a moving vehicle in an active work area.
Event Description: A worker walked behind a reversing forklift in an active loading area. The operator stopped after noticing the worker, preventing contact. No injury occurred.
Event Keywords: vehicle, line of fire, reversing forklift

Abstract Text: Hot work was started without confirming the permit and gas test.
Event Description: Contractors began welding near process equipment before the hot work permit was verified and without confirming the required gas test. Work was stopped by an HSE supervisor before ignition of combustible vapors occurred.
Event Keywords: hot work, permit to work, gas test
Human Factor: Permit and gas testing requirements not followed

Abstract Text: Worker sustained a minor hand cut while unpacking materials.
Event Description: A worker received a small superficial cut to the hand while opening packaging material with a utility knife. First aid was provided and the worker returned to normal duties.

Abstract Text: Worker entered excavation with inadequate access and unstable edges.
Event Description: A worker entered a 10-foot excavation where access was inadequate and loose soil was visible along the edge. The worker exited after the condition was identified. No collapse occurred and no injury resulted.

Abstract Text: Worker reported a blocked emergency exit.
Event Description: During a routine inspection, an emergency exit was found partially blocked by stored cartons. The cartons were removed immediately. No personnel were trapped or injured.
